scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB "npm run start:dev --workspace backend" "npm run start --workspace frontend"
scripts.db:generate: cd backend && npm exec prisma -- generate
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npm exec prisma -- migrate deploy
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm test --workspace backend -- --runInBand && npm test --workspace frontend -- --watch=false
